nodes.name: cached-uid-spring.xml
nodes.summary: Spring XML bean wiring for Baidu UID-generator's CachedUidGenerator with a DisposableWorkerIdAssigner, importing the shared MyBatis datasource configuration; RingBuffer tuning properties are documented but left at defaults.
nodes.languageNotes: Legacy spring-beans 3.1 XSD bean definitions; comments document RingBuffer boostPower/paddingFactor/scheduleInterval tuning knobs.

nodes.name: default-uid-spring.xml
nodes.summary: Spring XML bean wiring for Baidu UID-generator's DefaultUidGenerator, configuring snowflake bit allocation (timeBits=29, workerBits=21, seqBits=13, epoch 2016-09-20) with a DisposableWorkerIdAssigner.

nodes.name: mybatis-spring.xml
nodes.summary: Spring XML configuration for the UID generator's persistence layer: property placeholder loading uid/*.properties, Druid datasource, MyBatis SqlSessionFactory and mapper scanning for worker-node registration, plus transaction management.

nodes.name: mysql.properties
nodes.summary: JDBC connection and Druid connection-pool properties for the baidu-id MySQL database that stores UID worker-node assignments.
